notes: Each case: resolved_inputs, metadata, material_grades and section_designations per role, or an 'error' entry when merge_design_pref_sync raised.
Requests are built by the frontend from each module config (fixtures/design_pref_sync_inputs.json): core-keyed inputs, one entry per case.
Cases: open*, refresh*, save*, reset*; *_draft sends design_pref_draft, *_saved_overrides / *_stale_prefs put non-driver pref values in inputs, *_changed_driver moves the dock grade.
Header Plate Connection and Plate Girder have no core defaults (NO_CORE_DEFAULTS): defaulted_keys stays empty.

_core_defaults skips every key the core class does not answer (most flexure, compression and tension classes raise KeyError for some pref keys), so fewer defaults survive; the goldens pin which keys do.
Butt/Lap Joint modules have no material sync rules: no driver, no linked keys, no material rows.
